stages.active: The Shelter 34 purifier is failing. Ada thinks the Subway Union at Bleecker St Station has a spare filter cartridge.
stages.union: Marcus Bell will part with a filter cartridge if the tunnel rats on the platform are cleared, or for 150 caps, or for a working generator.
stages.got: You have a filter cartridge. Bring it to Overseer Ada at the Shelter 34 hatch.
stages.done: The purifier runs clean again. Shelter 34 can drink.

stages.active: Dutch Malloy's Wreckers hold the collapsed overpass and tax every water run. Deal with Dutch, one way or another.
stages.resolved: The overpass is settled. Tell Ada how it went.
stages.done: The water runs are safe. Lower Manhattan has a future.

stages.active: Milo's dog Rusty ran off toward the Con Ed crater. Find him.
stages.found: Rusty is following you. Take him home to Milo.

stages.active: Sister Odile wants the church bell's clapper back. It was carted off to the ruins on Bleecker Row.
stages.got: You found the bell clapper. Return it to Sister Odile.

stages.active: Deliver Rosa's sealed parcel to Old Tom by the overpass.
Velvet Jones needs a signal valve for her transmitter. The Union stores spares in a crate deep on the station platform.
stages.got: You have the signal valve. Bring it to Velvet at WKNY.
stages.done: Brass & Ash 88.1 is back on the air.
